capabilities.purpose: Find objects connected to a known anchor through governed relationship rules
useWhen: the anchor and bounded relationship pattern are known
doNotUseWhen: recursive traversal or arbitrary query execution is required
capabilities.resultSemantics: Authorized related objects returned by the UDP server-side fixed relationship plan
securityNotes: Gateway mediation and backend authorization are mandatory
No arbitrary query language or network destination input

capabilities.purpose: Read bounded current OUF MCP operational health from authoritative persisted recovery, debt, evidence and security state
useWhen: the user asks whether the MCP layer is healthy or whether OUF itself has unresolved orchestration problems
doNotUseWhen: raw logs, credentials, SQL or protected evidence payloads are requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Fixed PUBLIC_OPERATIONAL MCP snapshot: module, status, actionRequired, partial, visibilityClass and redacted; no incident references or counters
securityNotes: Authorization, admission, reconciliation and audit remain mandatory
Human-facing access is Gateway-mediated and channel-neutral; the private owner API never exposes the MCP protocol endpoint

capabilities.purpose: Read the current authorized ingestion/source operational state without raw logs
useWhen: the user asks whether ingestion or a source is healthy now
doNotUseWhen: raw telemetry or protected evidence is requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded current source health and latest run state
securityNotes: Tenant/source scope and redaction are enforced server-side
Gateway mediation is mandatory

capabilities.purpose: Read bounded historical ingestion runs including failures, retries and recovery context
useWhen: the user asks what happened to an ingestion/source in a past time window
doNotUseWhen: an unbounded audit export is requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded persisted run history for authorized sources
securityNotes: No secrets or raw stack traces
Gateway mediation is mandatory

capabilities.purpose: List authorized persisted operational incidents, including incidents that occurred while the chatbot was offline
useWhen: the user asks which problems are open, recovering or recently resolved
doNotUseWhen: security-sensitive protected evidence is requested without privileged authorization
capabilities.resultSemantics: Bounded cross-producer incident aggregates with lifecycle, severity and safe impact summaries; opt-in snapshot=true or cursor-only yields stable independently authorized owner-vector pages, consultationRecorded=false Publication coverage is opt-in and covers GATEWAY and INGESTION only; historical MCP self incidents are not covered. Read current urgent owner state separately. Publication positions do not prove client delivery, consultation, acknowledgement or resolution.
securityNotes: MCP aggregates only owner-provided governed projections
Unavailable producer evidence yields partial output and is never mapped to no incidents
A cursor is no authority, delivery receipt or operator checkpoint; each page freshly authorizes the root and both owners. Unavailable/redacted/changed snapshot pages fail without advancing.

capabilities.purpose: Explain one authorized operational incident using safe owner-provided classification and evidence references
useWhen: the user asks why a specific incident happened or what action is recommended
doNotUseWhen: no incident reference is known or raw protected evidence is requested
capabilities.resultSemantics: Owner-specific safe explanation with classification, severity, lifecycle, evidence reference and recommended action
securityNotes: The owner rechecks tenant scope and explain authorization
No raw stack traces, tokens or protected evidence payloads

capabilities.purpose: Summarize significant authorized operational events in a bounded time window for chatbot catch-up
useWhen: the user asks what happened while they were away or whether OUF had problems
doNotUseWhen: the user needs protected raw evidence
capabilities.resultSemantics: Safe cross-producer catch-up summary preserving DEGRADED, RECOVERING and partial semantics
securityNotes: Missing producer evidence must never be manufactured as HEALTHY
Producer calls remain independently Authorization- and Gateway-governed

capabilities.purpose: Commit an approved merge through the Trusted Human Surface
useWhen: a verified human is confirming an exact approved merge plan
doNotUseWhen: an AI agent or MCP client is attempting confirmation
capabilities.resultSemantics: Authoritative merge outcome owned by UDP
securityNotes: Never exposed in tools/list

capabilities.purpose: Inspect configured grants or the OUF application-role catalogue in the caller tenant; view ROLES returns roles and nominal/organizational assignments, not an IAM directory
useWhen: an authorized user requests permission administration
doNotUseWhen: confirming, publishing, changing superadmin association or editing IAM accounts
capabilities.resultSemantics: Configured grants or a bounded proposal receipt with trusted human review path; never an approval
securityNotes: Gateway verifies workload and delegation; owner reevaluates current policy
Confirmation is only on the direct authenticated THS; no human bearer is forwarded by MCP

capabilities.purpose: Create one native semantic DRAFT with a durable caller-scoped receipt
useWhen: preparing authorized native semantic proposals for human review
doNotUseWhen: approving, publishing, activating, adopting external terms or bypassing owner decisions
capabilities.resultSemantics: Owner receipt only; a review reference is not human approval or publication. Read current challenge in the THS before decision.
securityNotes: Current owner authorization and Gateway signed delegation are required
Stable commandKey is mandatory for mutation; ambiguous effects require receipt reconciliation
Owner and authority references are proposal values, not grants
